The company has said that people would reasonably expect this monitoring. The EDPB's Guidelines 3/2019 say reasonable expectations must be judged objectively, based on the actual circumstances — not just on what the individual personally expected. The guidelines add that employees generally do not expect their employer to monitor them at work. Posting signs may help meet transparency requirements, but signs alone do not decide what a person could reasonably expect. This guidance weighs against the company's position if an objective third party would not have expected the monitoring here. Section IV addresses whether that is the case. (EDPB, Guidelines 3/2019 on processing of personal data through video devices ¶37; EDPB Guidelines, adopted 29 January 2020 — interpretive guidance.)
